protocol.py: 4 biology problems (2 errors, 1 warning, 1 note).

1. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 8 ul is below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at least)
   line 66:  p300.aspirate(8, tube_rack['A1'])
   At line 66 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 8 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this
   line did it 18 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong
   amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator
   passes the move. Wells: tube A1 in slot 2.
   Affected: tube A1 in slot 2.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [e9c4cd2251ca]

2. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 2 ul is below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at least)
   line 74:  p300.aspirate(2, src_well)
   At line 74 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 2 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this
   line did it 18 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong
   amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator
   passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2 and 10 more in slot 1.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2 and 10 more in slot 1.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [38fe9d3599e1]

3. WARNING COLD-MODULE-NEVER-SET: A temperature module was loaded but never set
   line 74:  p300.aspirate(2, src_well)
   At line 74 the robot draws from wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2 and 10 more in slot
   1, on a temperature module that the protocol never sets. A temperature module stays at
   room temperature until `set_temperature` is called, so sample 1 (sample), sample 2
   (sample), sample 3 (sample), sample 4 (sample) and 2 more sat on a block that was never
   cold; the robot pipetted there 18 times over the run. The person setting up the deck sees
   a module and assumes it is cold. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2 and 10 more
   in slot 1.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2 and 10 more in slot 1.
   Fix: Call `temp_module.set_temperature(4)` before the first transfer from Opentrons 96
   Well Aluminum Block with Generic PCR Strip 200 µL in slot 1, and
   `temp_module.deactivate()` at the end.
   Source: Opentrons, temperature module: at room temperature until set_temperature, which
   blocks
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/modules/temperature_module.html
   Source: Thermo Fisher T4 ligase manual: keep on ice, use within minutes
           https://documents.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/t4dnaligase_1U_man.pdf
   Source: NEB: Q5 High-Fidelity PCR kit manual (add the polymerase last)
           https://www.neb.com/-/media/nebus/files/manuals/manuale0555.pdf
   [0c707843d37c]

4. NOTE UNMIXED-AT-END: 18 wells never mixed after sample 1, sample 2, sample 3, sample 4
and 14 more went in (20% of the well)
   line 75:  p300.dispense(2, well)
   At line 75 the robot added sample 1, sample 2, sample 3, sample 4 and 14 more to wells
   A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2 and 10 more in slot 3, which already held master mix (this
   line did it 18 times). The addition was 20% of the well, nothing mixed the well
   afterwards, and the run ended with them that way. Two liquids layered in a small well do
   not mix on their own, so what the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated.
   A PCR plate is usually vortexed and spun down before cycling; if this one will not be,
   mix it.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2 and 10 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Mix wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2 and 10 more in slot 3 after line 75:
   `mix_after=(5, 8)` on the transfer, or `pipette.mix(5, 8, well)`, with the volume about
   80% of what the well holds.
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Illumina: normalising library concentrations (pipette up and down 10 times to
   mix)
           https://support.illumina.com/ko-kr/bulletins/2017/03/best-practices-for-manually-normalizing-library-concentrations.html
   Source: Thermo PowerTrack user guide (a reaction plate not mixed well gives variable
   replicates)
           https://documents.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/MAN0018825_PowerTrackSYBRGreenMasterMix_UG.pdf
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   [bbe0c3094827]
